title: Web component binding
description: Framework-specific binding for wc. The semantic root element is declared once in packages/platform-web/components.json. A WC host tag is derived from component identity, independently of the semantic root.

component.description: Must match the contract's `component` and the file name. The custom element's TAG is derived from it — `TabItem` becomes `<ds-tab-item>` — rather than stored, because a tag that disagreed with the component name would be a second name for one thing.

contract.description: Relative path to the agnostic contract this realises.

framework.description: Named explicitly so a directory can hold more than one binding without ambiguity. `wc` rather than `web-components`, to match the package name.

delegatesFocus.description:
Whether the shadow root is attached with `delegatesFocus: true`, so focus landing on the host is forwarded to the first focusable node inside it.

THE FIRST BINDING FIELD IN THIS REPO THAT IS A PLATFORM FEATURE RATHER THAN A WORKAROUND FOR ONE. React's binding carries `refTarget` and says outright that it exists because React has no `delegatesFocus`; Angular reaches the host with `inject(ElementRef)`. Here the platform supplies it directly.

Omitted means: derived from the contract's `semantics.focusable`. Present means the contract's answer was overridden, and `notes` must say why.

propOverrides.description: Where a contract axis is exposed under a different attribute name, because the platform already owns the canonical one. Keyed by axis name.

reason.description: Required. A rename with no reason is drift with paperwork.
